chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: Mosley's marriage and Trent's wife Essie
summary: Mosley was married five years; discussion of Essie, her family in Fort Smith and the daughters.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I didn't know that; I never knew you were married.
Five years. Is she still living?
Five years. I'm working on my seventeenth.
(Inaudible) was married to the same woman--
Does she come from a well to do family too?
They weren't wealthy, but they were a nice family.
She was going to sell the whole place, I understand they persuaded her--it's a museum there now.
Essie had a daughter from another marriage and Trini had a daughter, but I don't know where it came from. He had a daughter.
